departments.name: Home
departments.blurb: For the house, and the things in it.

departments.name: Workshop
departments.blurb: For jobs that want doing, more or less.

departments.name: Desk
departments.blurb: For writing, measuring and keeping in order.

departments.name: Outdoors
departments.blurb: For the garden, the lane and the weather.

products.name: Candle, lightly used
products.summary: A white household candle. Lit once, for a test. It passed.
products.notes: We lit it on a Tuesday to be sure it worked, and put it out after four minutes. Roughly nine tenths remain. We have priced it at nine tenths.
products.drawingAlt: A candle with a slightly blackened wick.

products.name: Clock, stopped
products.summary: A wall clock showing ten past four. Correct twice daily, which is more than can be said for some.
products.notes: It has shown ten past four since it arrived. For best results, consult it at ten past four. A battery is not included and would not help.
products.drawingAlt: A round wall clock with its hands at ten past four.

products.name: Doorstop
products.summary: It is a brick. We see no reason to pretend otherwise.
products.notes: Stops doors of all sizes. We tested it on the garage door, which is the largest door we have, and the door stopped. Six remain of the original eleven. The other five are holding doors.
products.drawingAlt: A brick.

products.name: Mug, no handle
products.summary: A mug whose handle is no longer attached. Holds a full cup of tea.
products.notes: The handle came away in the post. We include it in the box, as it is yours. We recommend waiting for the tea to cool, or wearing Glove, right (item 24).
products.drawingAlt: A mug, with its handle lying beside it.

products.name: Teapot lid
products.summary: The lid of a brown teapot. The pot was sold separately, in error.
products.notes: If you bought a brown teapot from us in May, please write. Otherwise it sits well on a small saucepan, and keeps a cup of tea warm for longer than you would think.
products.drawingAlt: A teapot lid with a round knob.

products.name: Duster, feather
products.summary: A feather duster in good order. It has never itself been dusted.
products.notes: Everything in the shop is dusted on a Tuesday, with one of these. It did not seem right to dust the duster. It is therefore the only item we cannot vouch for in that respect.
products.drawingAlt: A feather duster with a wooden handle.

products.name: Coat hook, single
products.summary: One brass coat hook. Holds one coat.
products.notes: Screws are not included. See Screws, assorted (item 10), though we cannot promise two that match. We have hung Gerald's coat on one since March and it is still there.
products.drawingAlt: A single coat hook on a small back plate.

products.name: Jigsaw, 999 pieces
products.summary: A 1,000-piece jigsaw of Thrumble Viaduct. One piece is not present. Priced accordingly.
products.notes: We counted twice. The absent piece is sky, of which there is plenty left. The box says 1,000 and we have corrected it in pen.
products.drawingAlt: A jigsaw of a viaduct, with one piece missing from the sky.

products.name: Ladder, one rung
products.summary: A wooden ladder with one rung. Suitable for low shelves and modest ambitions.
products.notes: The rung is the bottom one, which is the one most people use first. The sides are a full six feet and in excellent condition. Not recommended for gutters.
products.drawingAlt: A tall ladder with a single rung near the bottom.

products.name: Screws, assorted (jar)
products.summary: A jam jar of screws. Most have partners.
products.notes: About 140 screws, collected over 31 years. No two jars are the same, and we would be surprised if any two screws were. The jar is included and has been washed.
products.drawingAlt: A jam jar full of screws.

products.name: Spirit level, slightly out
products.summary: A two-foot spirit level. Accurate to within reason.
products.notes: The bubble sits a little to the left of true. Once you know this you can allow for it, and we have written "allow for it" on the side. Our shelves were put up with it and nothing has rolled off that mattered.
products.drawingAlt: A spirit level with its bubble a little left of centre.

products.name: Batteries, flat (pack of 4)
products.summary: Four AA batteries with nothing left in them. Ideal for testing a battery tester.
products.notes: Each has been tested and found flat. They are the right size and shape in every respect. See Battery tester (item 13).
products.drawingAlt: Four batteries standing in a row.

products.name: Battery tester
products.summary: See Batteries, flat (item 12).
products.notes: Tests batteries. So far it has only given us bad news, but we believe it. We have no charged batteries with which to confirm what good news looks like.
products.drawingAlt: A battery tester with its needle resting at the low end of the dial.

products.name: Camera
products.summary: Sold in April. Listed for completeness.
products.notes: A good camera, which is why it sold. Since then the goods have been drawn rather than photographed. Gerald does the drawings in the evening. One customer has said she prefers them.
products.drawingAlt: A camera, drawn from memory.

products.name: Tape measure, starts at one metre
products.summary: A five-metre tape measure with the first metre missing. Measures four metres.
products.notes: Hold the end against the thing and take 100 centimetres off what you read. We have done this for years. The case is yellow and the spring is strong.
products.drawingAlt: A tape measure with a short length of tape pulled out.

products.name: Sandpaper, worn smooth
products.summary: A sheet of sandpaper that has done its work. For surfaces that are already nearly there.
products.notes: Coarse on arrival, in 1998. It now gives a very gentle finish. Sold singly. Nine sheets remain, all similar.
products.drawingAlt: A sheet of sandpaper, curled at one corner.

products.name: Calendar, last year's
products.summary: A wall calendar for 2025, with views of the district. Every date in it has been verified.
products.notes: All twelve months are present and each has the right number of days. August is the viaduct. The dates fall on the same weekdays again in 2031, and it will keep until then.
products.drawingAlt: A wall calendar open at a month, with a picture above the dates.

products.name: Pencil, sharpened both ends
products.summary: An HB pencil with a point at each end. Twice the writing. No rubber.
products.notes: When one end goes blunt, turn it round. Our most popular item, with seven sold. Please carry it with care.
products.drawingAlt: A pencil with a sharp point at both ends.

products.name: Envelopes, sealed (pack of 10)
products.summary: Ten white envelopes, sealed by the damp in the garage. Empty, and secure.
products.notes: They can be opened along the top with a knife and closed again with tape, which we do not supply. Good for anything that should look as though it has already been dealt with.
products.drawingAlt: A sealed envelope.

products.name: Key, spare
products.summary: A brass key. We have not yet found the lock. When we do, it will be listed separately.
products.notes: Well cut, of the Yale type. We have tried it in every lock at the garage and the house. It may be for the old shed, which was taken down in 2011.
products.drawingAlt: A door key.

products.name: Ruler, eleven inches
products.summary: A wooden ruler, shortened by one inch to fit the drawer. Accurate up to eleven.
products.notes: The inch removed was the twelfth, so everything before it can be trusted. The cut is clean. For twelve inches, measure eleven and then one.
products.drawingAlt: A ruler marked from nought to eleven.

products.name: Notebook, partly used
products.summary: A ruled notebook. The first six pages hold a list. The other 74 are free.
products.notes: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
products.drawingAlt: An open notebook with writing on the left-hand page.

products.name: Stamp, used
products.summary: A second-class stamp that has been to Carlisle. It cannot go again.
products.notes: For collectors, or for anyone who likes to know where a thing has been. Each is still on the corner of its envelope. Not valid for postage, as the Post Office has pointed out to us.
products.drawingAlt: A postage stamp with a postmark across one corner.

products.name: Glove, left
products.summary: A leather gardening glove for the left hand. For customers who already have the right one.
products.notes: Found on Viaduct Lane in March and never claimed. Size large. If it is yours, it is still £1.25, as we have looked after it.
products.drawingAlt: A single glove.

products.name: Umbrella, for indoor use
products.summary: A black umbrella with a small tear. Entirely reliable indoors.
products.notes: Opens and closes as it should. The tear lets in a modest amount of rain. We keep it open in the garage, where it has stayed perfectly dry.
products.drawingAlt: An open umbrella with a small tear in one panel.

products.name: Wellington boot, right
products.summary: One green wellington, size 9, for the right foot. Watertight.
products.notes: We filled it with water on a Monday and it was still full on the Wednesday. It has since been emptied. The left one was never ours.
products.drawingAlt: A single wellington boot.

products.name: Bird table, no legs
products.summary: The top of a bird table. Without the legs it is a tray, and the birds have not complained.
products.notes: Place it on the ground, a wall or another table. A robin has used it twice. The legs went to a neighbour for a different purpose and we have not asked.
products.drawingAlt: A small roofed bird table resting on the ground, with a bird on it.

products.name: Garden gnome, painted one side
products.summary: A gnome painted on the front only. Position against a wall.
products.notes: From the front he is complete: red hat, blue coat, fishing rod. The back is plain grey concrete. Against a wall or a hedge nobody will know, and we will not tell them.
products.drawingAlt: A garden gnome with a pointed hat and a fishing rod.

products.name: Bucket, draining
products.summary: A galvanised bucket with a hole near the bottom. Empties itself.
products.notes: Holds water for about a minute, which is long enough to carry it somewhere. Also good for gravel, apples and anything larger than the hole. The handle is sound.
products.drawingAlt: A bucket with a thin stream of water running from a hole near its base.

products.name: Compass
products.summary: A brass pocket compass. Points reliably towards the radiator.
products.notes: We believe it was left too long beside something magnetic. In the garage it has never once wavered. Elsewhere we cannot say, as it has not been elsewhere.
products.drawingAlt: A pocket compass.
